summary: For manual setup, create an OAuth application in AAP (Access Management > OAuth Applications): URL https://<baseDomain>, Default organization, Authorization code grant, Public client, space-separated redirect URIs such as https://<host>:443/callback and http://127.0.0.1/callback for flightctl login; then copy the Client ID into oAuthApplicationClientId.
questions: How do I create the OAuth application for Edge Manager manually?
What redirect URIs does Edge Manager need?
How do I separate multiple redirect URIs in AAP?
Which grant type and client type for the Edge Manager OAuth app?

answer_card.title: Manual OAuth application for Edge Manager
answer_card.answer_md:
*Access Management > OAuth Applications > Create OAuth application*

- **URL**: `https://<edge-manager-baseDomain>`
- **Organization**: Default
- **Authorization grant type**: Authorization code
- **Client**: Public
- **Redirect URIs** (space-separated): `https://<edge-manager-host>:443/callback` and, for `flightctl login`, `http://127.0.0.1/callback`

Copy the **Client ID** into `oAuthApplicationClientId` in `/etc/flightctl/service-config.yaml`.
